reason: A Web UI terminal panel that provides real interactive PTY-backed shell sessions with multiple tabs, shell selection, working-directory and environment configuration, output buffering, and process termination.

summaries.zh: 在 Web UI 中提供基于真实 PTY 的可交互 Shell 终端，支持多会话标签、Shell 切换、工作目录与环境变量配置。
summaries.en: Provides real PTY-backed interactive shell terminals in a Web UI with multiple sessions, shell selection, working-directory and environment configuration.

capabilities: Starts interactive shell sessions through node-pty
Executes arbitrary shell commands in the configured working directory
Supports selecting shells and setting environment variables
Maintains multiple terminal sessions and buffers output
Terminates shell processes and their process trees
